mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommend (user_id, agreement, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'Y', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT recommend_id, user_id, agreement, travel_purpose AS travelPurpose, companion FROM recommend WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommend (user_id, agreement, travel_purpose, companion, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'Y', #{travelPurpose}, #{companion}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.recommend_id AS recommendId, r.travel_purpose AS travelPurpose, r.companion AS companion, r.recommend_rating AS recommendRating, r.rating_content AS ratingContent, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.country_id AS countryId, r.city AS city, c.country_name AS countryNameKo, c.continent AS continent, c.img AS countryImg, c.iso_code AS isoCode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM recommend r JOIN country c ON r.country_id = c.country_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.recommend_id IS NOT NULL AND r.country_id IS NOT NULL AND r.travel_purpose IS NOT NULL AND r.companion IS NOT NULL AND r.recommend_rating IS NOT NULL AND r.rating_content IS NOT NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recommend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND recommend_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND country_id IS NOT NULL AND travel_purpose IS NOT NULL AND companion IS NOT NULL AND recommend_rating IS NOT NULL AND rating_content IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.country_name AS countryName, COUNT(r.recommend_id) AS count FROM recommend r JOIN country c ON r.country_id = c.country_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY count DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE RECOMMEND SET DELETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RECOMMEND_ID = #{recommendId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
